definition: Finite line content in this lab, independent of the order or subdivision of its drawing strokes.
A straight segment that cannot be extended along its carrier using line content already present.
The infinite straight line on which a nonzero segment lies.
The non-strict relation A ≤ S: all positive-length line content of A is covered by S.
Recognizing a transformed left-hand shape as a part of the current host.
Recognition of geometric parts not fixed by the original stroke decomposition.
No line elements, represented by an empty array in the core.
A particular transformation that establishes a rule’s applicability to a host.
A sequence of recorded rule applications from an initial shape.
A rule A→A, which can recognize a part without changing total geometry.
An exact ratio of integers with nonzero denominator.
x ∈ A says x is an element of the set A.
A ⊆ B says every element of A belongs to B.
P(A), the set whose elements are all subsets of A.
A×B, the set of ordered pairs with components in A and B respectively.
A rule assigning exactly one codomain element to every domain element.
The values actually attained by a function on its domain or a specified subset.
Inputs whose function values lie in a specified codomain subset.
A function that is both injective and surjective on its declared sets.
A reflexive, symmetric and transitive relation.
Disjoint nonempty blocks whose union is the whole set.
A set with an associative, closed binary operation, identity and inverses.
The order-eight symmetry group of a square in this course’s notation.
A bijection from a set to itself.
A group generated by powers of a single element.
A subset that forms a group under the inherited operation.
The smallest positive n with gⁿ=e, if one exists.
All positions of an object obtainable under the specified group action.
The subgroup of elements fixing the specified object under an action.
A map of groups preserving their operations.
The preimage of the target identity under a group homomorphism.
A subgroup invariant under conjugation by every element of the group.
The group of cosets of a normal subgroup with well-defined coset multiplication.
